THE DOUBLE-LISTING TRAP IS LIVE HERE and it is the reason the naive container facet is wrong: every record carries TWO container titles, a generic one ('Proceedings of the International Conference of the Learning Sciences') and a year-stamped one ('Proceedings of the 19th International Conference of the Learning Sciences - ICLS 2025'), so the all-time facet shows 1,779 + 620 + 604 + 555 and summing it double-counts. Filtering by publication year instead gives each meeting once.
The two tracks are one meeting and are summed once: ICLS 620 + CSCL 135 = 755 in 2025. The same pairing holds in 2024 (604 + 110 = 714) and 2023 (555 + 95 = 650).

Every 2025 record carries a page range, running up to 1809-1813, i.e. a proceedings volume of roughly 1,900 pages for 755 papers — about 2.5 pages each, the right shape for a mix of long papers, short papers and posters, and evidence the deposit is the whole volume rather than a subset.
Type facet for the year is a single value, Conference Paper 755, so nothing is hiding under another Crossref type.
ISLS has deposited only since 2023 (2 stray items in 2016); the series is 650 -> 714 -> 755, rising by about 50 a year.
